name: Wedgefield
description: A sector of fixed angle whose apex travels down the cell as the sheet descends.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 240deg at 50% @calc(4 + 92 * @y / @Y)%, #000 0 60deg, transparent 60deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 240deg at 50% @calc(4 + 92 * @y / @Y)%, #000 0 60deg, transparent 60deg 360deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
